title: Resize
text: Enlarge or shrink entire image or region of interest within image, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Interpolation method} sets Interpolation method; {Specify} sets the aspects of image to resize Output size as a percentage of input, {Resize factor in percentage} sets the percentage factor for input image transformation, {Number of output columns} sets the number of columns in output image, {Number of output rows} sets the number of rows in output image, {Number of output rows and columns} sets the number of rows and columns in output image, {Perform antialiasing when resize factor is between 0 and 100} prevents aliasing when shrinking image, {Enable ROI processing} enables ROI input and {Output flag indicating if ROI is within image bounds} enables flag indicating if specified ROI is outside input image. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: Input image or video matrix | array

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Resized output image or video matrix | array

params.name: Specify
params.values: Aspects of image to resize Output size as a percentage of input size (default) | Number of output columns and preserve aspect ratio | Number of output rows and preserve aspect ratio | Number of output rows and columns

params.name: Resize factor in percentage
params.values: Percentage factor for input image transformation [200 150] (default) | scalar | two-element vector

params.name: Number of output columns
params.values: Number of columns in output image 25 (default) | scalar

params.name: Number of output rows
params.values: Number of rows in output image 25 (default) | scalar

params.name: Number of output rows and columns
params.values: Number of rows and columns in output image [25 35] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Interpolation method
params.values: Interpolation method Bilinear (default) | Nearest neighbor | Bicubic | Lanczos2 | Lanczos3

params.name: Perform antialiasing when resize factor is between 0 and 100
params.values: Prevent aliasing when shrinking image off (default) | on

params.name: Output flag indicating if ROI is within image bounds
params.values: Enable flag indicating if specified ROI is outside input image region off (default) | on
